description:
Senior Full Stack Engineer Location

 Westlake, TX (Hybrid/Onsite)

 Job Summary

 We are seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Engineer to design, develop, and modernize enterprise-scale applications that support critical business functions. This role requires strong expertise in backend development, API design, cloud-native technologies, and modern software engineering practices. The ideal candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions while contributing to architectural decisions and mentoring development teams.

 Key Responsibilities

 
 Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and RESTful APIs.

 Build scalable, high-volume transactional systems with strong focus on performance, reliability, and security.

 Lead and contribute to the modernization and re-platforming of large legacy applications.

 Collaborate with product owners, business stakeholders, architects, and engineering teams to deliver end-to-end solutions.

 Design and implement microservices-based architectures and domain-driven solutions.

 Develop and deploy cloud-neutral applications across AWS and Azure environments.

 Participate in architecture reviews, design discussions, code reviews, and technical decision-making.

 Debug and analyze legacy systems to document current-state implementations and support migration efforts.

 Mentor junior and mid-level developers and promote engineering best practices.

 Create and maintain technical design documentation, architecture artifacts, and implementation guidelines.

 Support production deployments, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement initiatives.

 Foster collaboration across globally distributed teams.

 
 Required Qualifications

 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

 7+ years of software development experience in enterprise-scale applications.

 Strong expertise in Java and modern backend development frameworks.

 Extensive experience designing and building scalable RESTful APIs.

 Strong understanding of object-oriented analysis, design, and programming principles.

 Experience developing domain logic-intensive applications and distributed systems.

 Demonstrated experience leading technical teams and mentoring engineers.

 Experience modernizing or re-platforming legacy applications.

 Ability to analyze and document complex legacy systems to support modernization initiatives.

 Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

 
 Technical Skills Backend Development

 
 Java

 Spring Boot

 Spring Core

 Spring MVC

 RESTful API Development

 Microservices Architecture

 Domain-Driven Design (DDD)

 Cloud-native application development

 DevOps & CI/CD

 Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD)

 
 Development Tools

 
 IntelliJ IDEA

 Git-based Source Control Systems

 
 Testing & Quality Engineering

 
 Unit Testing

 Functional Testing

 Non-Functional Testing

 Cucumber

 SOATEST

 SOASTA

 
 Additional Technologies

 
 Mainframe Applications

 Legacy Systems (Java, .NET, C++)

 Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA)

 
 Preferred Qualifications

 
 Experience within financial services, banking, wealth management, insurance, or other regulated industries.

 Knowledge of Agile and Scrum methodologies.

 Experience with enterprise application modernization initiatives.

 Exposure to hybrid cloud and multi-cloud environments.

 Strong understanding of software architecture patterns and best practices.

 
 Core Competencies

 
 Technical Leadership

 Solution Architecture

 Collaborative Problem Solving

 Strategic Thinking

 Communication and Documentation

 Continuous Learning

 Team Mentorship

 Stakeholder Management

 Customer-Centric Mindset

 Organizational and Multi-tasking Skills

 
 What Success Looks Like

 
 Delivering scalable and reliable enterprise solutions.

 Driving modernization and cloud adoption initiatives.

 Improving system performance, maintainability, and operational efficiency.

 Establishing engineering best practices and development standards.

 Contributing to a culture of innovation, quality, and collaboration.

 
 This role is ideal for a senior engineer who is passionate about building robust backend systems, leading technical initiatives, and driving modernization efforts within a large-scale enterprise environment.

 

 

 

 

 

 Compensation, Benefits and Duration 

 Minimum Compensation: USD 35,000

 Maximum Compensation: USD 123,000

 Compensation is based on actual experience and qualifications of the candidate. The above is a reasonable and a good faith estimate for the role.

 Medical, vision, and dental benefits, 401k retirement plan, variable pay/incentives, paid time off, and paid holidays are available for full-time employees.

 This position is not available for independent contractors

 No applications will be considered if received more than 120 days after the date of this post
